两次输入的新密码不一致: The new passwords do not match
刚发送过，请稍后再试: Code just sent. Please try again later
协调器尚未启动，暂无网络信息。: The coordinator has not started, so there is no network information yet.
吊销「{name}」后，使用它的客户端会立即掉线。: Revoking "{name}" immediately disconnects clients using it.
吊销「{name}」后，使用它的客户端会立即掉线，包括当前浏览器会话。: Revoking "{name}" immediately disconnects clients using it, including this browser session.
同时吊销其他所有 token 和会话（本浏览器除外）: Also revoke all other tokens and sessions (except this browser)
复制失败，请手动选择复制: Copy failed. Please select and copy it manually
它只显示这一次，请立即复制保存：: It is shown only this once. Copy and save it now:
客户端按自己测得的延迟自动选择；「延迟」是协调器到该中继的往返时间，每 30 秒: Clients choose by the latency they measure themselves. "Latency" is the coordinator's round trip to the relay, updated every 30 seconds. "Reachable" means the coordinator holds a reservation on that relay.
尝试次数过多，请几分钟后再试: Too many attempts. Please try again in a few minutes
正数入账、负数出账，单位 credit: Positive is income, negative is spending, in credit
用于 sharetoken 客户端和脚本；浏览器会话也在这里: For the sharetoken client and scripts. Browser sessions are listed here too
用法：sharetoken 客户端 config.json 的 token 字段: Usage: the token field of the sharetoken client's config.json, or the HTTP header Authorization: Bearer …
管理功能需要重新登录并完成两步验证: Admin features require logging in again with two-factor authentication
管理员必须启用两步验证。用 Google Authenticator、Micro: Admins must enable two-factor authentication. Scan the QR code with Google Authenticator, Microsoft Authenticator, 1Password or similar, or enter the secret key manually, then enter the 6-digit code from the app to finish.
管理员登录必须通过验证器 App 的两步验证。更换手机时请让其他管理员在控制台重: Admin logins require two-factor authentication through an authenticator app. If you change phones, ask another admin to reset it in the console, or run portal mfa-reset on the server.
管理员账号需要两步验证，请输入验证器 App 显示的 6 位验证码。: Admin accounts require two-factor authentication. Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
绑定到此账户的 peer；它们花你的 credit、把收入记到你名下: Peers bound to this account. They spend your credit and earn in your name
绑定新设备需要设备私钥签名，所以要在那台机器上运行 {command}。解绑后协: Binding a new device requires a signature from its private key, so run {command} on that machine. After unbinding, the coordinator rejects the device immediately.
解绑「{name}」后它不能再用你的账户买卖；重新绑定需在该设备上再次登录。: After unbinding "{name}", it can no longer buy or sell with your account. To bind it again, log in on that device.
设置已超时，请重新登录: Setup timed out. Please log in again
请填写邮箱收到的验证码: Enter the code sent to your email
请求太频繁，请稍后再试: Too many requests. Please try again later
请用邮箱注册: Please sign up with an email address
还没有绑定设备。在你的机器上运行 {command} 即可把该设备绑定到此账户。: No devices bound yet. Run {command} on your machine to bind it to this account.
邮箱地址格式不正确: That email address is not valid
验证已超时，请重新登录: Verification timed out. Please log in again
验证码已发送，请查收邮件（也看看垃圾邮件）: Code sent. Check your email (and the spam folder)
验证码错误或已过期: The code is incorrect or expired
告诉我们你遇到的问题或建议。请不要填写密码、token 或 prompt 内容。: Tell us about a problem or an idea. Please don't include passwords, tokens or prompt content. We may reply to your account's email.
提交太频繁，请稍后再试: Sending too often. Please try again later
